headline: Sales grow but profits slip
summary_short: Revenue was KRW 1.22T, up 16.2% y/y, while operating profit fell 2.7% to KRW 68.9B and net profit fell 15.0% to KRW 44.9B.
summary_long: The comparison is against revenue of KRW 1.05T, operating profit of KRW 70.8B and net profit of KRW 52.8B a year earlier. Yahoo EPS was KRW 1,609 against KRW 1,886 a year ago, a 14.7% decline in line with net profit. No drivers or guidance are assessed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Revenue and profit figures come from a single third-party summary of a provisional filing; a second source gave a different net income, so treat these as unconfirmed. Percent changes are computed from the quoted figures.
